records.title: Rethinking Mamba in Speech Processing by Self-Supervised Models
records.reason: The study compares Mamba/self-supervised architectures for speech reconstruction and recognition. The evaluated outputs and task-specific modules are speech-processing systems, with no text-LLM serving or inference-cost technique; the Jamba citation is an architecture-family association only.

records.title: Extrapolation by Association: Length Generalization Transfer in Transformers
records.reason: The paper studies transfer of length generalization through joint training on algorithmic tasks and observes related effects in pretrained LMs. It does not extend a deployed context window or reduce the compute/memory cost of long-context inference; the YaRN citation is adjacent context-length work but the proposed contribution is a training/generalization analysis.

records.title: How Robust Are Router-LLMs? Analysis of the Fragility of LLM Routing Capabilities
records.reason: The benchmark finds routers can save cost yet route by category heuristics, with safety/efficiency failures; it proposes evaluation and recommendations rather than a new routing method.

records.title: VLM Is a Strong Reranker: Advancing Multimodal Retrieval-augmented Generation via Knowledge-enhanced Reranking and Noise-injected Training
records.reason: The paper’s stated contributions are image retrieval ranking and generator robustness, not reducing model inference resource use; no relevant serving optimization is claimed.

records.title: Neuro-symbolic Training for Reasoning over Spatial Language
records.reason: The method adds spatial-logic constraints during language-model training to improve nested spatial reasoning. It does not compress prompts, lower serving cost, or optimize inference; the cited context-compression paper is a separate inference mechanism and the present objective is reasoning quality.
